blurb: Skip the hassle of driving and experience the home of America's Team with round-trip transportation from downtown Dallas to The Star in Frisco, the Dallas Cowboys World Headquarters and Practice Facility. Unlike booking the stadium tour on your own, the experience includes comfortable transportation plus entertaining commentary from a knowledgeable local guide who shares the history of Dallas, Frisco, Texas football, and the legendary Dallas Cowboys during the journey. Upon arrival, enjoy the official 75-minute guided tour of The Star, including behind-the-scenes access to the Cowboys' headquarters and practice facilities (subject to availability). The complete experience, including transportation and free time at The Star District, lasts approximately 3.5 hours, making it the easiest and most enjoyable way to visit one of the NFL's most iconic destinations.
